newsitem.title: USA: MedPartners unit to distribute MS drug.
newsitem.headline: MedPartners unit to distribute MS drug.

text.p: Caremark International, a unit of MedPartners Inc, said Wednesday it will be the specialty distributor of an injectible drug to treat multiple sclerosis (MS).

Clinical studies show the drug Copaxone reduces the frequency of attacks in patients with relapsing-remitting MS, the company said. Copaxone will be commercially available in the United States this month, Caremark said.

Caremark's Therapeutic Services unit will provide direct home delivery national network of 21 specialty pharmacies or through the 54,000 retail pharmacies participating in Caremark's Multiple Sclerosis Prescription Drug Card program.
MedPartners shares were up 1/8 Wednesday at 22-1/2.
